stories.title: O que se sabe e o que falta saber sobre o caso de jovem morto com 27 tiros por PMs após celular ser confundido com arma em SP

en.title: What is known and what remains unclear about the case of a young man killed with 27 shots by police after his cell phone was mistaken for a weapon in SP
en.summary: A 20-year-old was killed by military police in São Paulo after officers mistook his cell phone for a weapon during a stop. Four officers fired 45 times total, hitting the victim with at least 27 shots.

stories.title: Lucas volta, Calleri marca dois e São Paulo derrota o Vitória no Morumbis

en.title: Lucas returns, Calleri scores two and São Paulo defeats Vitória at Morumbis
en.summary: São Paulo won 2-1 against Vitória in the 30th round of the Brazilian Championship at Morumbis with two goals from Calleri and Lucas Moura's return, with over 22,000 spectators in attendance.

stories.title: Lucas Moura volta, muda o jogo, e São Paulo conta com 2 de Calleri para bater o Vitória no MorumBis

en.title: Lucas Moura returns, changes the game, and São Paulo relies on 2 from Calleri to beat Vitória at MorumBis
en.summary: Lucas Moura returned and influenced São Paulo's performance as the team defeated Vitória with two goals from Calleri at Morumbis stadium.

stories.title: Telma de Souza, ex-prefeita de Santos, morre aos 82 anos

en.title: Telma de Souza, former mayor of Santos, dies at 82
en.summary: Telma de Souza, former mayor of Santos, passed away at the age of 82.

stories.title: Telma de Souza, única mulher eleita prefeita de Santos, morre aos 82 anos

en.title: Telma de Souza, only woman elected mayor of Santos, dies at 82
en.summary: Telma de Souza, former mayor of Santos and the only woman to be elected to lead the city, died at age 82. She had suffered a stroke and urinary tract infection while hospitalized.

stories.title: Acordão? Jair Bolsonaro solto, Flávio livre de Master e INSS e Moraes ‘esquecido’

en.title: Deal? Jair Bolsonaro released, Flávio free from Master and INSS and Moraes 'forgotten'
en.summary: The headline raises questions about legal developments involving Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Supreme Court Justice Moraes regarding various cases.

stories.title: E-mails indicam que Flávio dividiu conta bancária com advogado investigado na fraude do INSS

en.title: Emails indicate that Flávio shared bank account with lawyer investigated in INSS fraud
en.summary: Emails suggest that Flávio shared a bank account with a lawyer under investigation for alleged involvement in social security fraud.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula vê interferência da Meta após vídeos do petista baterem recorde de visualizações

en.title: Lula's campaign sees Meta interference after president's videos break viewership records
en.summary: Lula's campaign alleges that Meta is restricting the president's profile reach on its platforms after the profile achieved record video views.

stories.title: Emails indicam que Flávio Bolsonaro dividia conta com suspeito de lavar dinheiro do INSS

en.title: Emails indicate that Flávio Bolsonaro shared account with suspect in INSS money laundering
en.summary: Federal Police emails suggest presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro maintained a shared bank account with a lawyer suspected of involvement in social security fraud money laundering. Both deny the allegations.

stories.title: TSE dá 48 horas para que Meta esclareça possível restrição a posts da campanha de Lula

en.title: TSE gives Meta 48 hours to clarify possible restriction on Lula campaign posts
en.summary: Brazil's electoral authority has given Meta a deadline to explain potential restrictions placed on posts from President Lula's reelection campaign.

stories.title: O que se sabe sobre caso de mulher que teve prótese implantada no joelho errado após cirurgia no PR

en.title: What is known about case of woman who had prosthesis implanted in wrong knee after surgery in PR
en.summary: A woman underwent a surgical procedure in Paraná state where a knee prosthesis was implanted in the wrong location.

stories.title: Após retotalização dos votos, Douglas Ruas tem 50,88% dos votos no RJ

en.title: After vote retally, Douglas Ruas has 50.88% of votes in RJ
en.summary: Douglas Ruas secured 50.88% of votes in Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial first round after a retally, exceeding the threshold needed for election in the first round.

stories.title: Ministro do TSE derruba vídeo do vice de Flávio sobre suposto financiamento de Vorcaro a filme de Lula

en.title: TSE Minister Removes Video by Flávio's Running Mate About Alleged Vorcaro Financing of Lula Film
en.summary: A TSE minister ordered the removal of a video posted by Flávio Bolsonaro's vice-presidential candidate accusing President Lula of receiving bribes, citing an audio attributed to former banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding film financing.

stories.title: Flávio pede que TSE derrube canal ‘Exército do Lula’ no WhatsApp, e corregedoria quer esclarecimentos

en.title: Flávio Asks TSE to Remove 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp Channel, and Electoral Ombudsman Seeks Clarification
en.summary: An electoral ombudsman ordered candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to provide clarification within 72 hours regarding his request to remove a WhatsApp channel called 'Lula's Army' created by the politician.

stories.title: Lula aposta em conquistas sociais e Flávio promete mudanças, para abrir campanha do 2º turno

en.title: Lula Bets on Social Achievements and Flávio Promises Changes to Open Second Round Campaign
en.summary: President Lula's campaign emphasized preserving social policies and benefits, while candidate Flávio Bolsonaro focused on government proposals and refuting accusations during their opening of the second-round contest.

stories.title: Ratinho Jr declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno

en.title: Ratinho Jr Declares Support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Second Round
en.summary: The governor of Paraná announced his support for presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round runoff.

stories.title: Eleito governador do Rio, Douglas Ruas diz que segurança pública será prioridade

en.title: Newly elected Rio governor Douglas Ruas says public security will be priority
en.summary: Douglas Ruas, elected governor of Rio de Janeiro, stated that public security will be his administration's main priority. He plans to call upon approved security force candidates early in his term to strengthen the state's personnel.
